title: Setback to an adjoining right-of-way on lots less than 100 m2 (R100-SL)
text: Table 2.10a Modified provisions for housing on lots less than 100m2. 3.3 Street setbacks, C3.3.1: Right-of-way - 0.5m setback to adjoining right-of-way; and - nil street setback for upper floors.

replaces.note: current Part C Table 2.10a; values not compared

source.file: Residential Design Codes Chapter 3 - Grouped Dwellings.pdf

notes: Table 2.10a (Chapter 3 p26, register ch3-040) makes no primary/not-primary distinction for the right-of-way at R100-SL. Table 3A (p7) shows N/A in the not-primary row at R100-SL; inconsistent with Table 2.10a.

verified.note: Table 2.10a (p26) gives 0.5m to any adjoining right-of-way, but Table 3A (p7) prints N/A at R100-SL for a laneway that is not the primary street and '0.5m/Nil' where it is. Draft inconsistency between the two tables.
